summary.text: Tyler Davis is a no-party-affiliation candidate for Florida's 1st District. Describing herself as a woman and mother, she says she has worked in the financial industry for more than a decade and founded the nonprofit A Pensacola Perspective. She says she is running to give Northwest Florida a representative who listens and works with local communities.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Tate High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Pensacola State College in 2017, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as artist; in her own words, she has worked in the financial industry for more than a decade.

Founded and operates A Pensacola Perspective, a nonprofit focused on volunteerism, civic engagement, and local partnerships, which she says brings together residents, businesses, nonprofits, educators, and local governments.
Ballotpedia lists her as disqualified in the 2025 special election for this seat; she is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as a no-party-affiliation candidate.
